faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICSI IIP Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Managing Director position at ICSI IIP is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Managing Director role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Member of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India, The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, or The Institute of Cost Accountants of India. An MBA or a Law Graduate from a reputed institute is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the ICSI IIP Managing Director recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for the Managing Director post is 55 years. However, this can be relaxed up to 60 years by the Governing Board of ICSI IIP.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Managing Director position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Managing Director post will receive a consolidated compensation ranging from Rs. 24 Lacs to Rs. 30 Lacs per annum, approximately.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Managing Director post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the post of Managing Director at the ICSI Institute of Insolvency Professionals.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the ICSI IIP Managing Director recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the ICSI IIP Managing Director post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Managing Director recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Managing Director role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Managing Director position at ICSI IIP will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. When does the application link become active?
faq.answer: The application link for the ICSI IIP Managing Director recruitment will become active on 15 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICSI IIP located?
faq.answer: The ICSI Institute of Insolvency Professionals is located in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 201309.
